chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: It is not permissible for the one praying to pray in congregation unless there is an Imam for him, or he himself is the Imam.
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for a person to validly pray in congregation according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifying the structural validity of congregational prayer by establishing that a follower (muqtadi) must have a distinct Imam to follow, or lead themselves if alone. This hadith underscores the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on the necessity of a clear hierarchical leadership structure within the prayer unit, distinguishing it from mere collective gathering. It serves as a foundational proof for the requirement of an Imam in *salat al-jama'ah*, ensuring the prayer's validity through proper succession and authority.
